narrative_purpose: The cold-open image: a flying rider threading between two floating peaks at dawn, establishing the wrongness of rock that hangs where it should fall.
subject: A tall blue-skinned humanoid figure riding on the back of a large winged flying creature (leathery bat-like wings, long tail, four limbs), shown small and in silhouette mid-flight. The rider crosses the open gap between two enormous floating islands of grey rock, each with sheer cliff sides and dense blue-green forest on its flat top.
scene: Dawn above a white cloud deck. Thin waterfalls spill from the mesa tops and break into drifting mist before reaching anything below. Long hanging vines bridge the gap between the two peaks. A faint glowing mist in soft curving bands hangs around the lower rock.
camera: Wide aerial shot; the rider is tiny against the towering scale of the two suspended mountains framing the gap.
light: Low warm dawn light raking across the cliff faces from the right; cool blue-shadowed chasm in the centre gap; glow rising from the mist.
palette: Deep blue chasm, blue-green lit canopy, cyan mist, warm amber rim light on the cliff edges.
style: Painterly photorealistic concept art, strong sense of altitude and scale.
detail_level: Crisp on the near peak and the rider-and-creature silhouette; atmospheric haze softening the far peak.
composition: Two mountains at left and right framing a deep central gap of open sky; the rider on the lower-right thirds line crossing the void.
consistency_notes: Grey weathered rock, blue-green canopy, cyan-teal glowing mist; the winged mount has four limbs plus two wings and a long tail.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no logos, no closeup human faces, no oversaturation, no lens-flare clutter
